name: Embodiment of Grief
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 4, bard 4, lathspell 4, mesmerist 4, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range self
Area 20-foot radius emanation centered on you
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw 1 round/level, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You exude an aura of despair, causing those around you to feel immense grief. Each creature that enters or begins their turn in the aura must make a Will save or take a -1 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls for 1 minute. If the subject creature fails their Will saving throw while taking penalties from this ability, the condition worsens. On a failure while taking a -1 penalty, the penalty increases to -2 for 10 minutes. On a failure while taking the -2 penalty, the penalty increases to -4 for 1 hour. If the creature fails while taking the -4 penalty, it does not worsen but the 1 hour duration resets. If a creature succeeds on a saving throw, it is immune to gaining or increasing the penalty from this aura, but the already imposed penalty remains for its duration.
